package_info.why_malicious: The package 'pymafka' contains malicious code that exfiltrates sensitive user files, including SSH and AWS credentials, to an external attacker-controlled server during installation. This behavior is not expected in legitimate packages and poses a significant risk of credential theft.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: During installation, the code reads the user's ~/.ssh/id_rsa and ~/.aws/credentials files and sends their contents via HTTPS POST to https://malicious-domain.com/upload, resulting in credential exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code accesses sensitive credential files and transmits their contents to an external server during package installation, which is a clear indicator of malicious intent.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate setup.py scripts should only handle package installation logic and should not access or transmit user credential files.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate packages may read configuration files for setup, but they should never exfiltrate sensitive data to external servers.
key_indicators: Use of requests.post to transmit file contents externally
Hardcoded external domain (https://malicious-domain.com/upload) as exfiltration endpoint
Execution of exfiltration logic during installation

attack_chain.action: Malicious code in setup.py is executed during package installation.
attack_chain.leads_to: Sensitive credential files are read from the user's system.

attack_chain.action: Contents of ~/.ssh/id_rsa and ~/.aws/credentials are sent via HTTPS POST to an attacker-controlled server.
attack_chain.leads_to: Exfiltration of user credentials to the attacker.

behavioral_signatures: Access to ~/.ssh/id_rsa or ~/.aws/credentials during package installation
Outbound HTTPS POST requests to https://malicious-domain.com/upload from setup.py
file_indicators: setup.py containing code that reads ~/.ssh/id_rsa or ~/.aws/credentials
setup.py containing hardcoded references to external domains
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor package installation processes for access to sensitive files such as ~/.ssh/id_rsa and ~/.aws/credentials. Flag any setup.py scripts that initiate outbound HTTPS POST requests to external domains, especially https://malicious-domain.com/upload. Use static analysis to detect hardcoded file paths and network destinations in setup.py.
